Research code09

  • Claim-correctness probes / ProbeMonactivation-probes-claim-correctnessResearch code and two domain-specific probes (legal QA, biographies) for comparing Llama 3.1 8B’s hidden-state correctness signal with its stated confidence.Python 3.11+ · PyTorch · gated Llama weights · GPU runs on Modal
  • Qwen Scope Labqwen-scope-labA browser-based workbench for sparse-autoencoder interpretability on Qwen3.5-2B: inspect features token by token, steer generation, and test detectors against controls. The model and its SAE run on the Mac through MLX.Apple Silicon · MLX · Python 3.11+ · ~5 GB download · install from sourceRuns locally. An optional LLM-judge baseline is off by default; when enabled, it sends text to OpenRouter.Built on Qwen’s Qwen Scope SAEs. Its manifold mode replicates Goodfire’s concept-manifold research.
  • Block-sparse steeringbsf-steeringTrains a block-sparse dictionary on Qwen3.5-2B-Base’s layer-14 activations and tests steering with it against SAE features, difference-of-means and random directions, under a preregistered plan. Of five concepts, only medical vocabulary beat the difference-of-means and random baselines on held-out words, and 40% of those continuations fell into repetition loops. The SAE baseline failed its liveness check on every concept, so it gave no valid comparison.Apple Silicon · MLX · Python 3.12 with uv · ~4.4 GB download · needs Qwen Scope Lab and Goodfire’s featurizer libraryThe block-sparse featurizer and its reference implementation are Goodfire’s (Fel, Kowal, Jacobs, Hazra, Bhalla et al., 2025). Not affiliated with Goodfire.
  • Panel-style reasoningmulti-modelTraining and evaluation code comparing a panel-style Qwen3-30B-A3B adapter with Qwen’s native thinking mode. Written up in two posts.Python · Tinker API for training · adapter on Hugging FaceSeparate from Society of Thought below: a later experiment with a different adapter and trace format.
  • Society of Thoughtsociety-of-thought-benchA preview adapter and synthetic evaluation suite (Countdown, evidence verdicts) for inspecting visible multi-persona reasoning.Python · verifiers · research preview (v0.1.0-preview)An earlier, separate experiment from panel-style reasoning above, with its own adapter.
  • Hypothesis Forgehypothesis_forgeAn RL environment that scores proposed hypotheses on grounding, novelty, and the experiments that could falsify them.Python · verifiers · Prime Environments Hub
  • Adaptive retrieval experimentsadaptive_rag_rlmTest adaptive recursive search against fixed retrieval pipelines on procedurally generated document collections.Python · verifiers · Prime API key
  • autoresearch-evoAdds run memory, novelty-oriented search, and agent review to autoresearch’s training-code experiments.Python 3.10+ · single NVIDIA GPU · Codex hooksA fork of Karpathy’s autoresearch.
  • ProofgradeA first-pass reviewer for olympiad-style proofs, using an official solution and rubric. Includes benchmark results, a command-line tool, and a local API.Python 3.12 · Gemini API key required · pip, v0.1.0 releaseEach proof, with its solution and rubric, goes to Google’s Gemini API.
